subject: Testcase exchange — gatekeepers MAP & close cadence
messages:
From: Amira Khan <amira@retailco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@retailco.com
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: exchange of eval testcases & MAP kickoff

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the demo last week. RetailCo is ready to run a targeted evaluation of Redwood for our search-rewrite pipeline. We want to exchange a small set of testcases and a prompt pack so your team can validate quality+latency on a representative workload.

High-level asks from our side:
- A mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones (ingest, sandbox access, evaluation window, takedown).
- Clear usage constraints — ephemeral sandbox only, no repository persistence, deletion after 30 days.
- A short manifest describing each testcase (format, size, PII stamping).

We can share an initial manifest and PO template. Can Redwood confirm cadence for onboarding and who on your side will be the gatekeepers for security and legal sign-off?

Attachments: testcase_manifest.csv (stub), PO_template.docx (stub)

Best,
Amira
Head of ML Ops — RetailCo

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Khan <amira@retailco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: exchange of eval testcases & MAP kickoff

Amira — thanks, this is exactly the kind of scoped eval we prefer. I've drafted a short MAP with milestones and roles attached (MAP_draft_v1.xlsx). Key points up front:

- Scope: up to 5k testcases, ephemeral sandbox in our dedicated trial tenant, promptpack included for reproducibility.
- Usage constraints: sandbox-only, read-only export for RetailCo, automatic deletion 30 days after close; no model weight-sharing.
- Timeline we propose:
  * Day 0 (sign): MAP approved + NDA + PO issued
  * Day 2–3: RetailCo delivers manifest + sample testcases
  * Day 4–9: Redwood ingests, sanity checks, and provisions sandbox
  * Day 10–24: Evaluation window (2 weeks) with daily token/latency dashboards
  * Day 25–30: Pull results, mutual review, takedown audit

Ben and Vanessa — can you confirm the data handling checklist and whether the ingestion window needs additional gating? Also tagging internal owners for SOC2 evidence collection.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx (stub), promptpack_README.md (stub)

Thanks,
Soojin
Senior Sales Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Amira Khan <amira@retailco.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: exchange of eval testcases & MAP kickoff

Soojin / Amira — quick technical notes from ingestion/ops side:

- Manifest: please include sample count, avg token length, and a PII flag column (we will refuse any dataset with non-aggregated SSNs).
- Sandbox: we'll provision in our trial VPC with restricted egress. Access will be via ephemeral credentials valid for the eval window only.
- KV cache / logs: by default we keep request logs for 14 days for debugging; if RetailCo requires shorter retention we can set to 7 days per the MAP.
- Quotas: we recommend a 100k token cap per day during the window to control cost; we can raise if you need throughput.
- Legal gating: Vanessa — please confirm whether the usage language in the MAP is sufficient for procurement or if we need a formal MSA addendum.

Forwarding a short ingestion checklist below for Amira to confirm.

—Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 08:12 AM Amira Khan <amira@retailco.com> wrote:
> Thanks — will send manifest with PII column.
>

From: Amira Khan <amira@retailco.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@retailco.com
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: exchange of eval testcases & MAP kickoff

Soojin / Ben / Vanessa — appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement is looped for PO and timelines. A few edits from our side:

- Please switch request-log retention to 7 days.
- We need an explicit clause in the MAP that Redwood will not persist RetailCo testcases beyond the 30-day takedown window and will provide a takedown confirmation email and deletion audit (screenshot + job id).
- Can you add a short export control checkbox (no data leaves US region)?
- Our target close for the MAP + PO is Oct 15 so we can start the ingest the following week.

Procurement: procurement@retailco.com will finalize the PO; attached is our PO_template.docx with standard billing and PO number fields.

If Redwood confirms the 7-day log retention and takedown audit language today we can aim for signatures and PO by Oct 12–15.

Thanks — will get the manifest to you by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Amira
Head of ML Ops — RetailCo
